brief.name: The Long Dusk: lamplighter taste difference check
brief.brief: Design Ilo, the playable lamplighter of The Long Dusk, for one moment on the Vesper Cliffs: walking the cliff road, answering the keeper and waking the cold beacon. My audience loves Hollow Knight, Spirited Away, Sigur Rós, Nujabes and the film Paterson. Make Ilo a character this audience would want to play: their look, the way they move and the way they speak. Keep the world, its lore, the keeper and Ilo's fixed facts. Write the character's description and lines in English.

distance.method: 65% the character and 35% the moment. Character: visible palette CIE76 distance (25%), silhouette outline overlap and proportions (25%), gait, idle and turn parameters by their ranges (25%), signature clip timing and structure (10%), shared content words of the four lines (10%) and light colour (5%). Moment: scene colour CIE76 distance (30%), render style (25%), weather kind and density (15%), the music track (15%), the beacons' form (10%) and the mist (5%).

comparison.headline: 10 of 10 character devices in the Qloo on design rest on entities, tags or qualities the model did not predict.
comparison.qualityHeadline: 8 of 10 Qloo on devices translate measured qualities: the 9 look, mood and meaning tags the audience's works share, or its ranked style and aesthetic tags. Qloo off translated its own predicted qualities in 8 of 10.
comparison.detail: The model predicted 2 of 20 measured entities before seeing them; 18 were new to it. Of 9 shared qualities, 8 were not in its prediction.
comparison.sketchHeadline: Against each run's own frozen sketch, the Qloo on character moved 76% of its palette, proportions, planned elements and gait; the Qloo off character moved 4%. Its moment moved 92% of the sketched scene colours, weather, beacons, render style and track; Qloo off's moved 7%.
comparison.limitation: One pair. Character distance is a heuristic over tokens, outline and motion parameters, not a perceptual or quality measure. Compare repeated Qloo-to-baseline distances with baseline-to-baseline distances before claiming the difference exceeds model variance. Departure from the sketch is required of surprise-anchored devices, so it shows what measured data changed under this protocol, not an unprompted effect.
